description: Run ONE read-only SQL statement against the configured Snowflake account and return the rows. Read leaders only (SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH). Returns rows inline (up to max_rows, default 200, capped 1000); fails loud with snowflake.result_too_large over the inline caps — use export_query for the full result set as a workspace .tsv file.
embedding_description: Execute an ad-hoc read-only SQL query against the operator's Snowflake data warehouse, returning columns and rows inline for interactive inspection; a result too large for the inline caps fails loud rather than spilling. A single statement per call; the operator-granted role is read-only so writes are expected to fail at the warehouse. Use export_query for the full result set as a workspace .tsv file, list_databases/list_schemas/list_tables/describe_table to explore the warehouse schema first, test_connection to verify reachability and the active role.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with columns (ordered names) + rows (a list of row ARRAYS parallel to columns) + row_count + spilled=false.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count and show a few rows. Row data references potentially sensitive corporate warehouse content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Run a read-only SQL query against the configured Snowflake account.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.invalid_params: missing or empty sql. snowflake.read_only_violation: the statement is not a permitted read leader. snowflake.auth_failed: the key-pair JWT was rejected. snowflake.permission_denied: the role lacks privileges. snowflake.warehouse_suspended: the configured warehouse is suspended. snowflake.timeout: the query exceeded the statement timeout. snowflake.api_error: a query-syntax or other warehouse error. snowflake.result_too_large: the result exceeds the inline caps — this verb is for interactive reads only.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.read_only_violation: submit a single SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH statement. snowflake.warehouse_suspended: ask the operator to resume the warehouse. snowflake.timeout: narrow the query or add a LIMIT. snowflake.auth_failed/permission_denied: ask the operator to check the connecting user's key and role grants. snowflake.result_too_large: narrow the query (LIMIT / max_rows) for an interactive answer, or use export_query with an absolute output_tsv_path to land the full result as a workspace TSV.
